name: io.github.lumizone/postsider
title: PostSider
description: Social media calendar for AI agents: read channels, create drafts, request approval.

environmentVariables.name: POSTSIDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Organization API key from PostSider under Settings -> API.

environmentVariables.name: POSTSIDER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Instance base URL. Defaults to https://api.postsider.com and must be HTTPS for non-local hosts.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: PostSider MCP lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients inspect a real social media calendar, prepare native channel versions, create drafts, request approval and read publishing results through PostSider's public API.
